Written for the earlier single-user design; being revised for the org server (see ARCHITECTURE.md).

# Fonsviva

> The shared local compute and model-serving layer for UntoCaesar, Gantrel and Corunis. Status: planned, not released; check SUPPORTED.md before doing any step.

Cloud providers are personal use only and live only in Fonsviva. Apps never hold provider keys. UntoCaesar client work and Corunis are blocked from cloud.

## Setup
- [For agents: quickstart](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/agents): rules and order of steps
- [Install](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/install): steps, checks, expected output
- [Connect apps and agents](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/connect-fonsviva)
- [Select models](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/select-models)
- [Add a cloud provider](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/add-cloud-provider)
- [Troubleshoot](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/troubleshoot)

- [Cloud rules](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/CLOUD): personal use only, blocks and legal basis
- [Providers](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/providers): vetted cloud providers with sources
- [Adding compute](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/COMPUTE): machines, nodes, cloud; keychain keys, pairing, revoke
- [Costs](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/COSTS): power and cloud cost, budgets, spend protection
- [Jobs](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/JOBS): job types, statuses and CLI
- [Storage](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/STORAGE): disk use, dedupe, move, cleanup, quotas
- [Keys](https://students-of-local.github.io/Fonsviva/KEYS): org keys, scopes, limits, agent-made keys, safe sharing
